review_candidates.title: Support Engineer - Business Central
review_candidates.job_function: Customer Service, Information Technology, and Consulting
review_candidates.description: Positive, service-minded, decisive, and structured - if that’s you, keep reading! Continia Software is looking for a Business Central Support Engineer to join our Continia Banking support team. If you are ready to embrace new challenges and grow together with an international team, we have the job for you! About your role When you join Continia, you will become an integral part of an innovative, entrepreneurial, and agile environment. We foster a flat organizational structure, empowering you to speak up and actively contribute to bring Continia Customer Care to the next level. You can find more valuable information about our solutions on: Our solutions (continia.com) Your responsibilities will include, but not limited to the following tasks: Incident handling and stabilization Receive, assess, and prioritize incoming cases according to our defined severity framework. Perform structured troubleshooting to identify root causes or viable workarounds. Maintain clear communication with partners throughout the case. Keep full ownership of cases until resolution or formal escalation. Case quality and documentation Make sure incidents are documented in a clear and well-structured way. Contribute to and maintain our knowledge base articles. Continuous improvement Participate in testing and validating new features before release. Help identify recurring patterns and escalate structural issues to your team lead. Support our AI enabled support initiatives through accurate case documentation. Contribute feedback to improve support tools and processes. About you When you join Continia, you become part of a fast growing organization where new projects and products are always on the horizon. You thrive in such an environment, and you are helpful, open minded, and team oriented by nature. You are patient, eager to learn, and just as keen to explain things to others. Taking ownership of your tasks and executing them comes naturally to you. You are accountable and approach your work with a can do attitude. You know that not every problem can be solved alone, so you are comfortable turning to your colleagues, sparring on tricky cases, and finding the solution together. The team consists of 9 close colleagues, plus close cooperation with our development team and colleagues from other business units around the world. We imagine you have the following qualifications and characteristics: Proven experience with Dynamics NAV, Dynamics 365 Business Central or Continia solutions. Experience in the payments area. Experience in finance, or a basic understanding of accounting and bookkeeping processes, is desirable, though not a requirement. A keen interest in testing new functionality and maintaining support articles. A structured way of working, with the ability to handle multiple tasks and to collect and convey requests and ideas for new product features. Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of communicating fluently and effectively in English. Strong interpersonal skills, as you will engage with numerous internal and external stakeholders. A note from your manager: "We are a global team made up of people from different countries. Many of us are based in different locations, but thanks to our daily interactions with the teams, we all feel part of the team. We have fantastic partners who sell our products and implement them for customers, but even these partners sometimes need support. We are, in fact, also part of Continia’s success story, as our partners enjoy communicating with us and appreciate receiving prompt and expert assistance. If you cannot solve a problem on your own, your colleagues are there to help, and together you find a solution for the partner. Thanks to our experience, we can also contribute to further product development by writing user stories in DevOps, which are then implemented by the development department. The products, and we ourselves, are constantly evolving, so it is never boring." What we offer Continia is a culture-centric company, and we work on a mutual flexibility model, ensuring you have freedom with responsibility and a proper life balance. On top of this, you can enjoy the following extract of benefits: We offer an attractive salary package with a bonus scheme, pension and health insurance. Spectacular company events where you get to see colleagues from all around the world. How to apply If this position is calling your name, please send us your resumé through the application form together with a few lines about your motivation for applying for this job in English. Applications are reviewed continuously, and if you have any questions, we encourage you to contact Britta Siebken, Head of Support, Banking and Finance , via email: brsi@continia.com Continia commits to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all our job applicants with a valid residence and/or work permit. We look forward to hearing from you. About Continia At Continia, we value diversity and encourage authenticity. We are team players who respect each other's thoughts and ideas, and we expect everyone to take ownership of their work. We focus on personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization. In our day-to-day work, we are pragmatic and result-oriented and aim to stay entrepreneurial by keeping things simple and focusing on our employees. We celebrate our wins and releases and aim at having one major event each year where all employees meet up in one place. For more than 30 years, we have been adding value to users of Microsoft Dynamics by developing and offering solutions to effectively handle different types of administrative processes.

Με πολυετή εμπειρία και εξειδικευμένη ομάδα μηχανικών και τεχνικών, η εταιρεία υποστηρίζει έργα κατοικιών, επαγγελματικών χώρων, ξενοδοχειακών μονάδων και ιδιωτικών αναπτύξεων, καλύπτοντας τις ανάγκες από τη μελέτη και την επιλογή εξοπλισμού, έως την προμήθεια και την τεχνική υποστήριξη. Στο πλαίσιο της ανάπτυξής μας, αναζητούμε Μηχανικό Πωλήσεων / Τεχνικών Προσφορών για πλήρη απασχόληση, με έδρα την Αθήνα. Ο νέος συνεργάτης θα έχει ενεργό ρόλο στη μελέτη αιτημάτων, την επιλογή κατάλληλων προϊόντων, τη σύνταξη τεχνικών και οικονομικών προσφορών, καθώς και στην επικοινωνία με εγκαταστάτες, μηχανικούς, εργολάβους, τεχνικές εταιρείες και επαγγελματίες του χώρου. Η θέση συνδυάζει τεχνική γνώση, εμπορική αντίληψη και καθημερινή επικοινωνία με πελάτες και συνεργάτες. Κύριες αρμοδιότητες Ανάλυση των αναγκών κάθε έργου ή πελάτη Επιλογή κατάλληλου εξοπλισμού θέρμανσης, ψύξης και εξοικονόμησης ενέργειας Σύνταξη τεχνικών και οικονομικών προσφορών Υποστήριξη της διαδικασίας πώλησης με τεχνικές πληροφορίες και προτάσεις Επικοινωνία με εγκαταστάτες, μηχανικούς, εργολάβους και εταιρικούς πελάτες Παρουσίαση προϊόντων και τεχνικών λύσεων σε πελάτες και συνεργάτες Παρακολούθηση προσφορών και έργων Συνεργασία με τα εσωτερικά τμήματα πωλήσεων, αποθήκης, τεχνικής υποστήριξης και service Παροχή after-sales τεχνικής υποστήριξης όπου απαιτείται Συλλογή feedback από την αγορά και συμβολή στην ανάπτυξη του πελατολογίου Απαραίτητα προσόντα Πτυχίο Μηχανολόγου Μηχανικού, Ηλεκτρολόγου Μηχανικού ή συναφούς τεχνικής ειδικότητας Κατανόηση συστημάτων θέρμανσης, ψύξης ή ηλεκτρομηχανολογικών εγκαταστάσεων Ικανότητα επιλογής προϊόντων και σύνταξης τεχνικών προτάσεων Άνεση στην επικοινωνία με πελάτες και επαγγελματίες του τεχνικού κλάδου Οργανωτικότητα, συνέπεια και προσοχή στη λεπτομέρεια Καλή χρήση MS Office Δυνατότητα μετακινήσεων για επισκέψεις σε πελάτες και συνεργάτες, όπου απαιτείται Θα εκτιμηθεί Εμπειρία σε αντλίες θερμότητας, κλιματισμό, fan coils, δοχεία αδρανείας, ηλιακά συστήματα ή υδραυλικές εφαρμογές Προϋπηρεσία σε τεχνικές πωλήσεις, τεχνικές προσφορές ή υποστήριξη έργων Γνώση AutoCAD ή άλλου σχεδιαστικού προγράμματος Εμπειρία σε B2B πωλήσεις ή συνεργασία με εγκαταστάτες και τεχνικές εταιρείες Εμπορική αντίληψη και διάθεση για εξέλιξη Τι προσφέρουμε Σταθερό και οργανωμένο περιβάλλον εργασίας Συνεχή εκπαίδευση σε σύγχρονες τεχνολογίες θέρμανσης, ψύξης και εξοικονόμησης ενέργειας Συνεργασία με έμπειρη τεχνική και εμπορική ομάδα Επαφή με πραγματικά έργα και επαγγελματίες του κλάδου Προοπτικές εξέλιξης μέσα στην εταιρεία Ανταγωνιστικό πακέτο αποδοχών, ανάλογα με την εμπειρία και τις δυνατότητες του υποψηφίου Υβριδικό μοντέλο εργασίας, με παρουσία στην Αθήνα, επισκέψεις σε πελάτες/συνεργάτες και δυνατότητα εργασίας από απόσταση όπου το επιτρέπει η φύση της εργασίας Οι ενδιαφερόμενοι μπορούν να αποστείλουν το βιογραφικό τους στο παρακάτω email: th.datseris@mechanicalsolutions.gr

review_candidates.title: Sales Engineer. Industrial & Maintenance Solutions
review_candidates.description: ·        Location : Alexandria, Egypt (field-based — Borg el Arab, Sadat ,Qwesna) ·        0–5 years experience * Fresh grads welcome. For 30+ years, IDM has supplied Egypt’s heavy industry with the lubricants, filtration, and repair solutions that keep production lines, fleets, and heavy equipment running — including Schaeffer, a globally recognized name in industrial lubrication. We’re growing our field sales team and looking for Sales Engineers who want to build their own territory, not just manage an account list. What You’ll Do ? ·        Own a territory: identify and visit prospective industrial, marine/petroleum, construction, and fleet customers — not just service existing accounts. ·        Sell our core product lines : advanced lubricants, fuel and oil filters, filtration units, and repair welding alloys for industrial machinery, trucks, buses, generators, construction equipment, hydraulics, and turbines. ·        Run on-site workshop visits and hands-on field demonstrations, including cost-feasibility studies and trial installations - Diagnose mechanical issues on customer equipment and recommend the right IDM product or repair solution. Build proposals, negotiate pricing, and follow through on delivery, repairs, and payment - Report results back to customers and to IDM to keep growing the relationship. What We Offer ? ·        International technical and commercial training - ·        High commission structure + expenses, on top of a solid learning curve into industrial sales. ·        Car allowance ·        A clear path to international staff roles . ·        potential relocation to the Middle East or Africa with our distributor network . ·        Access to a unique, technically differentiated product line few competitors can match . What We’re Looking For ? ·        A degree in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent) ·        0–5 years in sales, mechanical engineering, or maintenance-related roles. — fresh grads with the right drive are genuinely welcome . ·        Comfortable being in the field daily (workshops, plants, job sites) rather than at a desk ·        Own a car and are based in or near Cairo ·        Strong communicator who’s motivated by solving technical problems and closing deals, not just relationship-servicing. ·         Bonus : exposure to petroleum, heavy equipment, fleet, marine, or generator maintenance

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer – Data Platforms
review_candidates.description: Department: Tech - Software Engineering Location: Oxford, UK Description Aurora helps governments, investors, and utilities make billion‑dollar decisions on the journey to net‑zero. Based in Oxford, you will work in a dynamic and growing engineering organisation that builds cloud-based software to track and model power grids around the world. Aurora's models produce some of the most data-intensive outputs in the energy industry – half hourly, generator-level simulations across 30-year horizons. As a founding Software Engineer on the Data Platforms team, you will build and own the infrastructure that makes that data fast, reliable, and useful. You will work in a small, fast-paced team that releases changes multiple times a day. The successful applicant will be an excellent problem solver, a strong team player, and a proven ability to take big projects from conception to production. We're open to a range of candidates - the role and compensation will reflect your experience. Key Responsibilities Build high-uptime platforms that serve 100TB -1PB data fast and reliably Build tools and platforms that empower engineers, modellers, and analysts across Aurora Be a founding member of the Data Platforms team - shaping its culture, practices, and technical direction from the ground up Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Required attributes: 3+ years developing impactful, mission-critical backend systems The ability to work in fast-paced, high-ownership environments Excellence in one or more language (we mostly use Python) Strong discipline in testing and automation Experienced, judicious user of AI coding tools An exceptional team player - low-ego, high-initiative Genuine interest in the transformation of energy markets and infrastructure Desirable attributes: Hands-on experience with large distributed systems Previous experience building data platform - including scheduling, streaming, storage, compute Python, Lakehouse architectures, Terraform, AWS What we offer Some of the benefits we include are: Private Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Parental Support Salary-Exchange Pension Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) Local Oxford Discounts Cycle-to-work Scheme Flu Jabs At AER, we are committed to offering flexibility in the way we work. Most of our roles are hybrid with a mix of in-office/home working and potentially adjustable working hours. Let’s discuss what works for you and AER during the interview process. The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavourable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy, and maternity. To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period. Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.
